jobs.title: Réserve Client Experience & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Company**  
Founded in 2014 by Jerome Jacques Marie Mage, Jacques Marie Mage is a Los Angeles-based producer of limited-edition designer goods specializing in the micro-production of luxury eyewear for a clientele of discerning tastes.  
With each new collection, JMM embraces a unique palette of precious materials, rich colors, and striking geometric forms, which cleverly reference and beautifully reconfigure the striking individuals, artistic movements, and world events of previous centuries. All JMM eyewear is ethically sourced and produced with the utmost respect for industry partners' environment and wellbeing.

**About the Role**  
As Jacques Marie Mage expands Réserve, its members-only program offering archival eyewear and collectible objects through curated releases and auctions, we are seeking an organized and proactive intern to support the program’s daily operations and development.  
Based in Los Angeles and reporting to the Head of Réserve, the intern will work closely with teams across the company to support member relations, product launches, inventory coordination, communications, and events. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a growing luxury program that combines commerce, collecting, and personalized service.

**Responsibilities:**  

* Membership Support: Assist with membership application reviews, onboarding, and database updates, keeping member information accurate and organized.
* Client Experience: Support member inquiries and personalized requests, including product

availability, account access, and order follow-ups, coordinating with internal teams and galleries.  

* Launch Preparation & Sourcing: Help prepare curated releases and auctions, including product information, imagery, pricing uploads, and website checks ahead of launch. Assist in sourcing vintage objects for the program.
* Inventory & Fulfillment: Maintain product and inventory trackers and coordinate with warehouse and gallery teams on transfers and packaging.
* Member Communications: Assist with preparing and scheduling newsletters in collaboration with brand, design, and e-commerce teams.
* Events & Gifting: Assist with member events, gifting, and gallery initiatives.
* Reporting & Organization: Help prepare sales reports, maintain project trackers and calendars, and contribute to improvements in daily workflows.

**Key Requirements:**  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
* Previous internship or work experience in luxury, retail, or e-commerce is required.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to deliver a high standard of luxury client service, with discretion and respect for client confidentiality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Sheets. Familiarity with Shopify,

Klaviyo, or NetSuite is a plus.  

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively with creative teams, and follow

through on tasks.  

* Interest in luxury goods, eyewear, design, art, or collectible objects.
* Previous experience in client service, retail, e-commerce, or operations is a plus.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**  
Jacques Marie Mage is a company that respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. We promote initiatives aimed at supporting professional equality for everyone. We strive to go above and beyond purely symbolic measures by building a culture focused on meaningful strategies aimed at creating an inclusive workforce.

**Our Benefits**  
Jacques Marie Mage provides a comprehensive and thoughtfully designed benefits package for full-time employees. These offerings reflect our commitment to supporting and valuing our team.  

* Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with up to 100% employer contribution and FSA options.
* Retirement Plan: 401(k) with 4% company match after 90 days.
* Life & Disability Insurance: Company-paid life insurance plus optional long-term disability

coverage.  

* Eyewear Perks: Access to exclusive seasonal product allowances and discounts.
* Employee Assistance Program: 24/7 confidential support services.
* Additional Benefits: Pet, auto, and home insurance, commuter benefits, identity theft protection.
* Time Off: Major holidays, birthday off, vacation, sick time, and winter break.
* Community Engagement: Volunteer opportunities through the JMM Stewardship Program.

jobs.title: Social Media & Public Relations Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are seeking a versatile and creative Social Media & Public Relations Coordinator to help amplify Nacelle's digital presence and brand voice. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our social content, from graphic design and video editing, to community management and paid ads. The ideal candidate is a proactive mind who thrives in a fast-paced environment and who has a deep knowledge of the social media landscape, trends, influencers in the space, etc.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Content Production & Asset Creation: Design graphics and promotional materials using Photoshop.
* Video Editing: Cut, edit, and assemble short- and long-form video content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and dedicated YouTube clips. (Adobe premiere experience is preferred)
* Social Media Management: Schedule, publish, and oversee day-to-day posts across all major platforms (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Facebook, YouTube).
* Community Management: Monitor channels, engage with audiences, respond to comments and messages, and foster an active online community.
* Paid Campaigns: Assist in creating, launching, and monitoring social media ad creative and copy.
* PR & Communications Support: Help draft press releases, media pitches, and public relations announcements as needed.
* Analytics & Reporting: Track performance metrics across organic and paid channels to optimize content performance.

  

QUALIFICATIONS:

* 2 years of experience managing social media accounts for a brand or agency.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro).
* Demonstrated portfolio of visual content, short-form video, and YouTube edits.
* Solid copywriting skills for social captions, ad copy, and PR drafting.
* Familiarity with social media and YouTube management tools.

  

HOURLY RANGE:

$22 - $23 per hour

WORK LOCATION:

This is an on-site position. Candidates must be able to work from our Burbank office during scheduled work hours (9AM – 6PM).

ABOUT THE NACELLE COMPANY:

Founded by Brian Volk Weiss, The Nacelle Company develops, produces, and distributes feature and documentary films as well as TV shows – both scripted and unscripted. Nacelle’s vast array of partnerships include: Netflix, Amazon, Disney +, HBO, Discovery, BET+, A&E Networks, Hulu, Viacom, and many more. The Nacelle Company has produced the hit Netflix docu-series, Down To Earth with Zac Efron, The Movies That Made Us, and The Toys That Made Us, as well as Behind The Attraction for Disney +, Sony’s Mad About You reboot, Netflix’s How To Fix A Drug Scandal, Netflix’s Kevin Hart’s Guide To Black History, All The Way Black for BET+, and Grant for The History Channel.

The job duties listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification and are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and committed to Diversity and Inclusion.

We adhere to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.description:
Program & Project Coordinator (5257C), Bakar ClimatEnginuity Hub - #89253 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Bakar Labs is the consortium of biotech and climate tech incubators made up of four locations: Bakar Bio Labs at Berkeley, Bakar Bio Labs at UCSF, Bakar Labs for Energy and Materials, and the IGI-Bakar Labs Expansion.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
As Bakar Labs for Energy & Materials expands towards opening a new incubator facility in mid-2028, the Program & Project Coordinator works closely with a team of three to provide entrepreneurship programming and recruit early-stage energy and materials companies for a pilot program. This position applies project management and analytical skills to oversee the day-to-day administration and execution of Bakar Labs for Energy & Materials initiatives, including fellowship programs, events, workshops, and campus/industry partnerships.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
**The First Review Date for this job is:** October 16, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Program Operations & Administration - 35%
  
  
Manages day-to-day operational coordination of Bakar Labs programs, including developing and maintaining program systems, tracking milestones and deliverables, organizing scheduling across multiple concurrent activities, and managing founder and participant communications. Proactively identifies operational bottlenecks and implements process improvements to enhance program efficiency and participant experience.
  
  
Events & Workshop Management - 20%
  
  
Leads end-to-end logistical planning and execution of in-person and virtual events including founder workshops, speaker series, demo days, and community gatherings. Owns project timelines, vendor contracts, budget tracking, venue coordination, and post-event evaluation; applies findings to continuously improve event operations.
  
  
Partnerships & Campus Collaborations - 25%
  
  
Serves as primary operational point of contact for industry partners, sponsors, and campus collaborators including schools, departments, research centers, and student organizations. Manages deliverable tracking, maintains partner records, and coordinates stewardship touchpoints. Develops and maintains organizational systems to support relationship management across a portfolio of external and campus partners; coordinates joint activities and ensures commitments are met on time.
  
  
Fellowship Program Administration - 10%
  
  
Manages operational administration of fellowship winners and grantees including building and tracking ongoing progress, support and introductions, and managing program reports. Develops and refines operational workflows to support program scalability.
  
  
Project Management & Organizational Systems - 10%
  
  
Maintains and continuously improves project management infrastructure including tracking tools, dashboards, status reports, and documentation systems. Develops standardized templates and operational playbooks to support consistent program delivery. Supports leadership with data organization and reporting for strategic planning purposes.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to build and manage operational systems, workflows, and tracking tools across multiple concurrent programs and projects.
  
Proficiency with project management methodologies and tools (e.g. Asana, Notion, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or equivalent); ability to develop and maintain project plans, dashboards, and status reports.
  
Demonstrated ability to independently manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a high degree of operational autonomy.
  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with diverse audiences including startup founders, industry partners, campus collaborators, and university leadership.
  
Experience coordinating operational logistics for programs, events, or projects involving multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams.
  
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with a wide range of internal and external partners including campus departments, research centers, and industry organizations.
  
Ability to identify process inefficiencies and develop practical, scalable operational improvements and standard operating procedures.
  
Proficiency with Google Workspace and common collaboration and productivity platforms.
  
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality with sensitive institutional, partner, and program information.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Familiarity with the startup, venture, or innovation ecosystem, particularly in deep tech, life sciences, or climate technology

We need a hands-on creator who can **think of ideas, shoot, edit, write, publish, and learn from what works.**

* Creative, curious, and highly visual

* Proactive - you bring ideas rather than waiting for instructions

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to Founder & CEO
jobs.description:
About BYou Laser Clinic

BYou Laser Clinic is a growing medical aesthetics and laser clinic dedicated to delivering exceptional client experiences, outstanding results, and a high standard of care.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an exceptional **Executive Assistant to the Founder & CEO** who is highly organized, proactive, polished, and genuinely enjoys being the person who keeps everything moving.

This is a high-trust, high-visibility position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working closely with a business owner.

The Role

As Executive Assistant to the Founder & CEO, you will be a trusted partner in managing the CEO's time, priorities, communication, and day-to-day business activities.

You will act as the right hand to the Founder & CEO, helping create structure, staying ahead of priorities, following up on commitments, and ensuring important details never fall through the cracks.

The ideal candidate is someone who doesn't simply wait for instructions. You anticipate what is needed, identify problems before they become problems, and take ownership from start to finish.

You are confident, professional, discreet, highly organized, and comfortable interacting with employees, clients, vendors, business partners, and other senior stakeholders.

Executive Support

* Manage the Founder & CEO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and competing priorities
* Proactively organize and protect the CEO's time
* Prepare the CEO for upcoming meetings by ensuring agendas, documents, reports, and relevant information are ready
* Attend meetings when required, take detailed notes, and convert discussions into clear action items
* Maintain and follow up on the CEO's task list and outstanding commitments
* Track deadlines and deliverables across the business
* Follow up with team members, vendors, and external partners on outstanding items
* Prepare correspondence, presentations, reports, proposals, and other business documents
* Draft professional emails and communications on behalf of the CEO
* Coordinate meetings and communications with internal and external stakeholders
* Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries, reservations, and logistics when required
* Manage confidential business, financial, employee, and personal information with absolute discretion
* Maintain organized digital files and records across Microsoft 365 and SharePoint
* Help the CEO stay focused on high-value priorities by managing administrative details proactively

Business & Project Coordination

* Act as a central point of coordination for projects initiated by the Founder & CEO
* Track projects, deadlines, responsibilities, and next steps
* Maintain project plans and task lists using Asana or similar project-management software
* Follow up with team members to ensure commitments are completed on time
* Identify delays, gaps, or potential issues and bring them to the CEO's attention early
* Prepare weekly or monthly status updates for leadership
* Support special projects, business initiatives, and growth opportunities
* Assist with research, data gathering, and preparation of decision-making materials
* Help turn the CEO's ideas into organized action plans

Communication & Relationship Management

* Serve as a professional and responsive point of contact between the CEO and key stakeholders
* Communicate confidently with employees, clients, vendors, consultants, and business partners
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and confidentiality in all interactions
* Ensure important communications are followed through to completion
* Build positive working relationships across the organization
* Represent the CEO and BYou Laser Clinic with professionalism and warmth

People & HR Support

While the primary focus of this position is executive support, the role will also assist with selected HR and people-related responsibilities, including:

* Supporting recruitment coordination, interview scheduling, and onboarding
* Maintaining employee documentation and records
* Coordinating employee communications and announcements
* Supporting staff meetings, training, and team events
* Assisting with employee recognition and engagement initiatives
* Tracking training, certifications, and other employee requirements
* Supporting payroll preparation and benefits administration
* Assisting with HR projects and documentation
* Supporting the CEO with confidential employee-related matters

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is **exceptionally organized, proactive, polished, and dependable**.

You are the type of person who:

* Thinks two steps ahead
* Notices the details others miss
* Doesn't need to be reminded twice
* Can manage a constantly changing calendar without becoming overwhelmed
* Knows how to prioritize when everything feels urgent
* Takes ownership rather than simply completing tasks
* Communicates clearly and professionally
* Is comfortable following up and holding people accountable
* Handles confidential information with maturity and discretion
* Remains calm and solutions-focused under pressure
* Can switch seamlessly between high-level business priorities and small administrative details
* Understands that being an exceptional Executive Assistant means making the CEO's life easier

Most importantly, **you are someone the Founder & CEO can trust completely.**

Requirements

* 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting a Founder, CEO, President, or senior executive
* Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars and competing priorities
* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to draft professional correspondence with minimal direction
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
* Experience with project-management software such as Asana is an asset
* Strong Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, conditional form

jobs.title: Administrative & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Administrative & Operations Coordinator

About the role

We are a small automotive-care products company seeking an experienced Administrative & Operations Coordinator to support office operations, billing, light accounting, and company-wide administrative follow-through.

You will work with our team, vendors, customers, and accountant to keep records organized, paperwork accurate, and routine responsibilities moving. We need someone who takes ownership, establishes practical systems, and maintains them independently.

What you’ll own

* **Office organization and filing:** Organize and maintain physical and digital files, process incoming paperwork, and make important records easy to retrieve.
* **Customer billing:** Prepare and issue invoices in QuickBooks, maintain supporting documentation, track outstanding balances, and coordinate routine payment follow-up.
* **Purchase orders:** Prepare and track vendor purchase orders for approved purchases. Match customer purchase orders to orders and invoices, checking quantities, pricing, and required billing references.
* **Vendor administration:** Maintain vendor records, coordinate supplier communications, track orders and deliveries, and follow up on missing paperwork or discrepancies.
* **Light accounting and bookkeeping support:** Enter routine transactions and bills, organize receipts and deposit documentation, review records for missing information, and prepare supporting materials for the accountant.
* **Bills and credit-card paperwork:** Gather documentation, identify questionable charges or discrepancies, and coordinate approved inquiries and corrections.
* **Payroll administration:** Gather and check payroll inputs, flag discrepancies for review, and maintain approved payroll records.
* **Task tracking and follow-through:** Capture approved assignments in ClickUp, record owners and deadlines, follow up with team members, and flag delays or decisions needed. Prepare concise weekly progress updates.
* **General administration and project support:** Handle scheduling, correspondence, meeting preparation, office supplies, supplier sample requests, and administrative coordination for approved company projects.
* **Founder support:** Help organize priorities, notes, and paperwork, particularly during the initial setup. Provide occasional, clearly defined personal administrative assistance.

What you bring

* Experience in office administration, administrative coordination, or office management.
* QuickBooks experience.
* Familiarity with customer billing, vendor bills, purchase orders, and supporting financial records.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, task-management software, email, calendars, and digital filing systems.
* Sound judgment about what you can resolve independently and what requires approval.
* Professional communication and discretion with confidential information.
* The ability to work effectively across a small team and manage changing priorities.

Responsibilities and approvals

You will own routine preparation, recordkeeping, and follow-up within established procedures. The accountant will oversee accounting practices, reconciliations, taxes, and financial reporting. Purchasing commitments, payments, and final payroll approval will follow designated approval procedures.

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* The filing backlog is organized and incoming paperwork is handled consistently.
* Customer invoices are accurate and timely, with outstanding balances followed up.
* Vendor bills and purchase-order records are complete and easy to locate.
* The accountant receives organized, accurate supporting information.
* Approved assignments are tracked, with clear weekly updates.
* Team members can find the information they need and spend less time chasing paperwork and routine follow-ups.

Expected hours: 32.0 – 40.0 per week

* Vision insurance

Based in Los Angeles and reporting to the Head of Réserve, the intern will work closely with teams across the company to support member relations, product launches, inventory coordination, communications, and events. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a growing luxury program that combines commerce, collecting, and personalized service.

**Responsibilities:**  

* Membership Support: Assist with membership application reviews, onboarding, and database updates, keeping member information accurate and organized.
* Client Experience: Support member inquiries and personalized requests, including product

availability, account access, and order follow-ups, coordinating with internal teams and galleries.  

* Launch Preparation & Sourcing: Help prepare curated releases and auctions, including product information, imagery, pricing uploads, and website checks ahead of launch. Assist in sourcing vintage objects for the program.
* Inventory & Fulfillment: Maintain product and inventory trackers and coordinate with warehouse and gallery teams on transfers and packaging.
* Member Communications: Assist with preparing and scheduling newsletters in collaboration with brand, design, and e-commerce teams.
* Events & Gifting: Assist with member events, gifting, and gallery initiatives.
* Reporting & Organization: Help prepare sales reports, maintain project trackers and calendars, and contribute to improvements in daily workflows.

**Key Requirements:**  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
* Previous internship or work experience in luxury, retail, or e-commerce is required.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to deliver a high standard of luxury client service, with discretion and respect for client confidentiality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Sheets. Familiarity with Shopify,

Klaviyo, or NetSuite is a plus.  

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively with creative teams, and follow

through on tasks.  

* Interest in luxury goods, eyewear, design, art, or collectible objects.
* Previous experience in client service, retail, e-commerce, or operations is a plus.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**  
Jacques Marie Mage is a company that respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. We promote initiatives aimed at supporting professional equality for everyone. We strive to go above and beyond purely symbolic measures by building a culture focused on meaningful strategies aimed at creating an inclusive workforce.

**Our Benefits**  
Jacques Marie Mage provides a comprehensive and thoughtfully designed benefits package for full-time employees. These offerings reflect our commitment to supporting and valuing our team.  

* Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with up to 100% employer contribution and FSA options.
* Retirement Plan: 401(k) with 4% company match after 90 days.
* Life & Disability Insurance: Company-paid life insurance plus optional long-term disability

coverage.  

* Eyewear Perks: Access to exclusive seasonal product allowances and discounts.
* Employee Assistance Program: 24/7 confidential support services.
* Additional Benefits: Pet, auto, and home insurance, commuter benefits, identity theft protection.
* Time Off: Major holidays, birthday off, vacation, sick time, and winter break.
* Community Engagement: Volunteer opportunities through the JMM Stewardship Program.

new_jobs.title: Content Creator & Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Content Creator & Social Media Manager - GOBI STUDIO**

**Location:** New York City  
**Part-Time | 15–20 hours/week**  
**$25–$35/hour, depending on experience and portfolio**  
**In-person content creation required**

**About GOBI STUDIO**

GOBI STUDIO is a new Pop-Up and e-commerce brand bringing Georgian design, craftsmanship, and culture to New York through a curated collection of handmade ceramics, home goods, textiles, accessories, and unique objects.

We are building our social presence **from zero** and are looking for a creative, social-native person to help us launch and grow GOBI on Instagram and TikTok.

**The Role**

We are **not looking for someone who simply schedules posts.**

We need a hands-on creator who can **think of ideas, shoot, edit, write, publish, and learn from what works.**

You will help turn GOBI's products, Georgian design stories, NYC culture, behind-the-scenes moments, and events into content people want to watch, save, and share. You help make GOBI recognizable online.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and manage GOBI's Instagram and TikTok from the ground up
* Develop a simple content strategy and weekly content calendar
* Create Reels, TikToks, Stories, photos, and carousels
* Create both **social-first short-form content and visually polished, cinematic brand videos**
* Shoot and edit content using a smartphone and/or camera
* Write strong hooks, captions, and on-screen text
* Research trends, sounds, formats, and cultural moments
* Tell stories about Georgian designers, craftsmanship, products, and culture
* Create behind-the-scenes and founder/store content
* Capture product arrivals, pop-up preparations, opening events, and collaborations
* Engage with the community and monitor content performance
* Test new ideas and improve content based on results

**Who We're Looking For**

You are:

* Creative, curious, and highly visual
* Naturally interested in Instagram, TikTok, and current trends
* Strong at short-form video and photography
* Comfortable editing independently
* A good storyteller and writer
* Proactive - you bring ideas rather than waiting for instructions
* Organized, reliable, and comfortable working independently
* Comfortable occasionally appearing on camera or directing others
* Interested in design, fashion, interiors, culture, lifestyle, or creative brands

**1–3 years of experience is preferred, but portfolio matters more than a degree.** Freelance, personal, internship, or creator experience is welcome.

**Tools**

Experience with **CapCut, Canva, Instagram Edits, Adobe, or similar tools** is a plus.

A professional camera is **not required**. Strong creative thinking and the ability to create quality content are more important.

**How to Apply**

Please send:

* Resume or short professional background
* Instagram/TikTok/portfolio link
* **3–5 examples of content you personally created**
* Your expected hourly rate

**No degree or large personal following required. We care about what you can create.**

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10018

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant to Founder & CEO
new_jobs.description:
About BYou Laser Clinic

BYou Laser Clinic is a growing medical aesthetics and laser clinic dedicated to delivering exceptional client experiences, outstanding results, and a high standard of care.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an exceptional **Executive Assistant to the Founder & CEO** who is highly organized, proactive, polished, and genuinely enjoys being the person who keeps everything moving.

This is a high-trust, high-visibility position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working closely with a business owner.

The Role

As Executive Assistant to the Founder & CEO, you will be a trusted partner in managing the CEO's time, priorities, communication, and day-to-day business activities.

You will act as the right hand to the Founder & CEO, helping create structure, staying ahead of priorities, following up on commitments, and ensuring important details never fall through the cracks.

The ideal candidate is someone who doesn't simply wait for instructions. You anticipate what is needed, identify problems before they become problems, and take ownership from start to finish.

You are confident, professional, discreet, highly organized, and comfortable interacting with employees, clients, vendors, business partners, and other senior stakeholders.

Executive Support

* Manage the Founder & CEO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and competing priorities
* Proactively organize and protect the CEO's time
* Prepare the CEO for upcoming meetings by ensuring agendas, documents, reports, and relevant information are ready
* Attend meetings when required, take detailed notes, and convert discussions into clear action items
* Maintain and follow up on the CEO's task list and outstanding commitments
* Track deadlines and deliverables across the business
* Follow up with team members, vendors, and external partners on outstanding items
* Prepare correspondence, presentations, reports, proposals, and other business documents
* Draft professional emails and communications on behalf of the CEO
* Coordinate meetings and communications with internal and external stakeholders
* Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries, reservations, and logistics when required
* Manage confidential business, financial, employee, and personal information with absolute discretion
* Maintain organized digital files and records across Microsoft 365 and SharePoint
* Help the CEO stay focused on high-value priorities by managing administrative details proactively

Business & Project Coordination

* Act as a central point of coordination for projects initiated by the Founder & CEO
* Track projects, deadlines, responsibilities, and next steps
* Maintain project plans and task lists using Asana or similar project-management software
* Follow up with team members to ensure commitments are completed on time
* Identify delays, gaps, or potential issues and bring them to the CEO's attention early
* Prepare weekly or monthly status updates for leadership
* Support special projects, business initiatives, and growth opportunities
* Assist with research, data gathering, and preparation of decision-making materials
* Help turn the CEO's ideas into organized action plans

Communication & Relationship Management

* Serve as a professional and responsive point of contact between the CEO and key stakeholders
* Communicate confidently with employees, clients, vendors, consultants, and business partners
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and confidentiality in all interactions
* Ensure important communications are followed through to completion
* Build positive working relationships across the organization
* Represent the CEO and BYou Laser Clinic with professionalism and warmth

People & HR Support

While the primary focus of this position is executive support, the role will also assist with selected HR and people-related responsibilities, including:

* Supporting recruitment coordination, interview scheduling, and onboarding
* Maintaining employee documentation and records
* Coordinating employee communications and announcements
* Supporting staff meetings, training, and team events
* Assisting with employee recognition and engagement initiatives
* Tracking training, certifications, and other employee requirements
* Supporting payroll preparation and benefits administration
* Assisting with HR projects and documentation
* Supporting the CEO with confidential employee-related matters

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is **exceptionally organized, proactive, polished, and dependable**.

You are the type of person who:

* Thinks two steps ahead
* Notices the details others miss
* Doesn't need to be reminded twice
* Can manage a constantly changing calendar without becoming overwhelmed
* Knows how to prioritize when everything feels urgent
* Takes ownership rather than simply completing tasks
* Communicates clearly and professionally
* Is comfortable following up and holding people accountable
* Handles confidential information with maturity and discretion
* Remains calm and solutions-focused under pressure
* Can switch seamlessly between high-level business priorities and small administrative details
* Understands that being an exceptional Executive Assistant means making the CEO's life easier

Most importantly, **you are someone the Founder & CEO can trust completely.**

Requirements

* 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting a Founder, CEO, President, or senior executive
* Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars and competing priorities
* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to draft professional correspondence with minimal direction
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
* Experience with project-management software such as Asana is an asset
* Strong Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, conditional form
